bluf: Stickyeyes is a Leeds and London search and content marketing agency owned by Interpublic Group (IPG), selling SEO, content and digital PR to enterprise brands including Hertz, Kroger and KPMG. Its status on record is uncertain: a June 2026 capture still presents the brand, but homepage news stops at March 2021, sitemap content stops June 2024, no own ads surfaced and trading status is unconfirmed. Horus reads it Exposed at -17.5. The one thing a rival should know: every client on record comes from a case study, the dated ones running 2017 to 2021, which makes 16 named enterprise relationships contestable by anyone who calls.
doing:
The positioning line reads: Leeds and London search and content marketing agency, backed by IPG, pairing passionate people with in-house technology for proven results. In plain words, a holdco owned SEO and content shop selling stability and tenure. The headline claim is exactly that: long client tenures, including an 11 year GHD partnership and seven plus years with Hertz, and the prominence signals add 54,000+ colleagues across Interpublic Group.

The sold mix leads with two lines at score 3. Content & Digital PR: the site title brands it a content marketing agency, Digital PR sits in the navigation, and content and PR cases cover GHD, Gala Casino and LG. SEO: the homepage leads with Search Marketing, Content, Strategy, with SEO case studies for Solopress, CWT and Instantprint. Web & Product scores 2 on a Design & Development navigation section and web build cases for Family Traveller, Norton Finance and an LG microsite. Nine more lines score 1 (PPC, paid social, programmatic, CSS, marketplace optimisation, analytics, CRO, B2B, creator); AI automation, AI search and local score 0; breadth 12. The record lists no proprietary product and no partner beyond the parent.

AI posture is null: the record carries no AI statement, service or content, and 0 AI topic URLs sit in a 1789 URL sitemap.

Dated moves: one only, an undated homepage item near March 2021 posts in which Jonny Artis and Lee Allen were given global holding agency roles. The newest dated case studies are Hertz, Kroger and KPMG at 2021-01-06; the newest resource is a US sportsbook search spotlight at 2022-07-22. No news, no jobs and no ATS are in the record.

Pricing signals are absent. What is conspicuously absent for an IPG search agency: any AI search or generative line, any own advertising (0 Google ads, 0 LinkedIn ads), any content since 2022 in the record, and any office beyond Leeds and London.
clients:
The client type on record is enterprise, across iGaming, travel, financial services, retail, professional services, beauty, media and print; the home market is the UK from Leeds and London.

The record names 16 clients: 11 observed and 5 names only, all from case studies, none shared with another tracked agency. CWT came for organic demand, PR and brand: the 2020-04-21 case describes migrating 160 international domains and overhauling SEO and content marketing. GHD came for the same three: the 2020-05-07 case describes an 11 year partnership on brand protection, SEO visibility and customer engagement. Solopress (2017-10-23), Instantprint (2017-10-18) and OnStride Finance (2017-10-23) came for organic demand, PR and brand: penalty recovery, technical SEO, content marketing and a brand launch with paid search. Gala Casino (2017-10-13) came for PR and organic demand, Hilton Worldwide (2017-10-13) for organic demand through influencer outreach, LG & Activision (2019-02-18) for PR and brand around the Call of Duty tie up, KPMG (2021-01-06) for lead generation, Lloyds of London (2017-10-18) for PR, and Family Traveller (2017-10-18) for brand and web build.

Hertz and Kroger carry case pages dated 2021-01-06 (a seven year global relationship; a complete digital transformation) but the read assigned no need code from their titles; MTV Europe, Norton Finance and Maximuscle have no captured excerpt. Their needs are inferred from the SEO and content it leads with.
